const IDENT = r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$"
const KEY = r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|\[(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)\])*$"
const NAME =
    r"^(?:\.|@(?:index|number|first|last)|(?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\.(?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|0|[1-9][0-9]*))*)$"
const NUMBER = r"^-?[0-9]{1,9}\z"
const FILTERS = split(
    "upper lower title trim length first last reverse items comma sum min max default eq pad lpad truncate replace join sort pluck add sub mul div mod gt lt",
)
struct TemplateError <: Exception
    number::Int
    reason::String
end
fail(n, s) = throw(TemplateError(n, s))
part(s, a, b = length(s)) = a > b ? "" : String(s[a:b])
trim(s) = String(strip(s, ' '))
haspart(v, p) = p isa String ? v isa Dict && haskey(v, p) : v isa Vector && 0 <= p < length(v)
getpart(v, p) = v[p isa Integer ? p+1 : p]
function put!(v, p, x)
    if v isa Vector && p == length(v)
        push!(v, x)
    else
        v[p isa Integer ? p+1 : p] = x
    end
end
function keyparts(key, n)
    occursin(KEY, key) || fail(n, "bad key '$key'")
    [
        (
            m.captures[1] === nothing ? parse(Int, m.captures[2]) : String(m.captures[1]),
            part(key, 1, m.offset+length(m.match)-1),
        ) for m in eachmatch(r"([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)|\[([0-9]+)\]", key)
    ]
end
function scalar(s, at)
    if at <= length(s) && s[at] == '"'
        out = IOBuffer()
        at += 1
        while at <= length(s)
            c = s[at]
            at += 1
            c == '"' && return String(take!(out)), at
            if c == '\\'
                at <= length(s) || error("value")
                c = s[at]
                at += 1
                c in ('"', '\\', 'n') || error("value")
                c == 'n' && (c = '\n')
            end
            print(out, c)
        end
        error("value")
    end
    finish = at
    while finish <= length(s) && !(s[finish] in ",]")
        finish += 1
    end
    word = part(s, at, finish-1)
    word == "true" && return true, finish
    word == "false" && return false, finish
    occursin(r"^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$", word) || error("value")
    parse(Int, word), finish
end
function value(s, n)
    try
        s == "[]" && return Any[]
        s == "{}" && return Dict{String,Any}()
        if startswith(s, "[")
            list = Any[]
            at = 2
            while true
                x, at = scalar(s, at)
                push!(list, x)
                part(s, at) == "]" && return list
                startswith(part(s, at), ", ") || error("value")
                at += 2
            end
        end
        x, at = scalar(s, 1)
        at == length(s)+1 || error("value")
        x
    catch
        fail(n, "bad value '$s'")
    end
end
function assign!(root, line, n)
    separator = findfirst(" = ", line)
    separator === nothing && fail(n, "bad line")
    key = part(line, 1, first(separator)-1)
    parts = keyparts(key, n)
    x = value(part(line, last(separator)+1), n)
    current = root
    for (i, (p, prefix)) in enumerate(parts)
        p isa Int && p > length(current) && fail(n, "index gap at '$prefix'")
        if i == length(parts)
            put!(current, p, x)
            break
        end
        kind = parts[i+1][1] isa String ? Dict : Vector
        if haspart(current, p)
            getpart(current, p) isa kind || fail(n, "type conflict at '$prefix'")
        else
            put!(current, p, kind === Dict ? Dict{String,Any}() : Any[])
        end
        current = getpart(current, p)
    end
end
function unset!(root, key, n)
    parts = keyparts(key, n)
    current = root
    for (i, (p, _)) in enumerate(parts)
        haspart(current, p) || fail(n, "no value at '$key'")
        if i == length(parts)
            current isa Vector ? deleteat!(current, p+1) : delete!(current, p)
        else
            current = getpart(current, p)
        end
    end
end
truth(v) = v !== nothing && (v isa Bool ? v : v isa Int ? v != 0 : !isempty(v))
function text(v, n)
    v === nothing && return ""
    v isa String && return v
    v isa Bool && return v ? "true" : "false"
    v isa Int && return string(v)
    v isa Vector && return join((text(x, n) for x in v), ", ")
    fail(n, "cannot render map")
end
function number(v, f, n)
    v === nothing && return 0
    v isa Int && !(v isa Bool) && return v
    v isa String && occursin(NUMBER, v) && return parse(Int, v)
    fail(n, "not a number for '$f'")
end
function unquoted(s, separator)
    result = String[]
    at = 1
    quoted = false
    for i in eachindex(s)
        if s[i] == '\''
            quoted = !quoted
        elseif s[i] == separator && !quoted
            push!(result, part(s, at, i-1))
            at=i+1
        end
    end
    push!(result, part(s, at))
    result
end
function argumentsvalid(f, a)
    ints = all(x->x isa Int, a)
    strings = all(x->x isa String, a)
    f in ("default", "eq") && return length(a)==1
    f in ("pad", "lpad") && return length(a) in (1, 2) &&
           a[1] isa Int &&
           a[1]>=0 &&
           (length(a)==1 || a[2] isa String && length(a[2])==1)
    f=="truncate" && return length(a)==1 && ints && a[1]>=0
    f=="replace" && return length(a)==2 && strings && !isempty(a[1])
    f in ("join", "pluck") && return length(a)==1 && strings
    f=="sort" && return length(a)<=1 && strings
    f in ("div", "mod") && return length(a)==1 && ints && a[1]!=0
    f in ("add", "sub", "mul", "gt", "lt") && return length(a)==1 && ints
    isempty(a)
end
function expression(s, n)
    pieces = unquoted(s, '|')
    name = trim(pieces[1])
    occursin(NAME, name) || fail(n, "invalid name '$name'")
    filters = Tuple{String,Vector{Any}}[]
    for piece in pieces[2:end]
        fields = unquoted(trim(piece), ':')
        f = fields[1]
        f in FILTERS || fail(n, "unknown filter '$f'")
        a = Any[]
        for raw in fields[2:end]
            if occursin(r"^'[^']*'$", raw)
                push!(a, part(raw, 2, length(raw)-1))
            elseif occursin(NUMBER, raw)
                push!(a, parse(Int, raw))
            else
                fail(n, "bad arguments for '$f'")
            end
        end
        argumentsvalid(f, a) || fail(n, "bad arguments for '$f'")
        push!(filters, (f, a))
    end
    name, filters
end
mutable struct Node
    kind::Char
    number::Int
    argument::String
    expression::Any
    children::Vector{Node}
    indent::String
end
Node(k, n, s) = Node(k, n, s, nothing, Node[], "")
function source(lines)
    opening="{{"
    closing="}}"
    roots=Node[]
    targets=[roots]
    stack=Node[]
    for (n, line) in lines
        tokens=Node[]
        at=1
        while true
            found=findnext(opening, line, at)
            if found===nothing
                push!(tokens, Node('t', n, part(line, at)))
                break
            end
            start=first(found)
            push!(tokens, Node('t', n, part(line, at, start-1)))
            after=start+length(opening)
            triple=startswith(part(line, after), "{")
            stop=triple ? "}"*closing : closing
            finish=findnext(stop, line, after+triple)
            finish===nothing && fail(n, "unclosed tag")
            content=trim(part(line, after+triple, first(finish)-1))
            at=last(finish)+1
            k=triple ? '&' : !isempty(content) && first(content) in "#^/!>&=" ? first(content) : 'v'
            arg=k in ('v', '=') || triple ? content : trim(part(content, 2))
            tag=Node(k, n, arg)
            if k=='='
                fields=length(content)>=2 && endswith(content, "=") ?
                       split(part(content, 2, length(content)-1), ' '; keepempty = false) : String[]
                length(fields)==2 && all(x->!occursin('=', x), fields) ||
                    fail(n, "invalid delimiters")
                opening, closing=String.(fields)
            elseif k in ('v', '&', '#', '^')
                tag.expression=expression(arg, n)
                k in ('#', '^') && push!(stack, tag)
            elseif k=='/'
                occursin(NAME, arg) || fail(n, "invalid name '$arg'")
                isempty(stack) && fail(n, "unexpected closing '$arg'")
                expected=last(stack).expression[1]
                arg==expected || fail(n, "mismatched closing '$arg', expected '$expected'")
                pop!(stack)
            elseif k=='>'
                occursin(IDENT, arg) || fail(n, "invalid name '$arg'")
            end
            push!(tokens, tag)
        end
        tags=filter(x->x.kind!='t', tokens)
        standalone=length(tags)==1 &&
                   tags[1].kind in "#^/!>=" &&
                   all(x->x.kind!='t' || isempty(trim(x.argument)), tokens)
        if standalone
            tags[1].kind=='>' && (tags[1].indent=tokens[1].argument)
            tokens=tags
        else
            push!(tokens, Node('t', n, "\n"))
        end
        for node in tokens
            if node.kind=='/'
                pop!(targets)
            elseif node.kind in ('#', '^')
                push!(last(targets), node)
                push!(targets, node.children)
            elseif !(node.kind in ('!', '='))
                push!(last(targets), node)
            end
        end
    end
    !isempty(stack) && fail(last(stack).number, "unclosed section '$(last(stack).expression[1])'")
    roots
end
field(v, k) = v isa Dict ? get(v, k, nothing) : nothing
rank(v) =
    v===nothing ? (0, 0) :
    v isa Bool ? (3, Int(v)) : v isa Int ? (1, v) : v isa String ? (2, v) : (4, 0)
function applyfilter(f, a, v, n)
    f=="upper" && return uppercase(text(v, n))
    f=="lower" && return lowercase(text(v, n))
    if f=="title"
        s=text(v, n)
        return join(
            i==1 || s[i-1]==' ' ? uppercase(string(s[i])) : lowercase(string(s[i])) for
            i in eachindex(s)
        )
    end
    f=="trim" && return trim(text(v, n))
    f=="length" && return v isa Union{Vector,Dict} ? length(v) : length(text(v, n))
    f in ("first", "last") &&
        return !(v isa Vector) ? v : isempty(v) ? nothing : f=="first" ? first(v) : last(v)
    f=="reverse" && return v isa Union{Vector,String} ? reverse(v) : v
    f=="items" && return v isa Dict ?
           Any[Dict{String,Any}("key"=>k, "value"=>v[k]) for k in sort!(collect(keys(v)))] : v
    if f=="comma"
        x=number(v, f, n)
        s=string(abs(x))
        groups=String[]
        while length(s)>3
            pushfirst!(groups, part(s, length(s)-2))
            s=part(s, 1, length(s)-3)
        end
        return (x<0 ? "-" : "")*join(pushfirst!(groups, s), ",")
    end
    if f in ("sum", "min", "max")
        v isa Vector || return number(v, f, n)
        nums=[number(x, f, n) for x in v]
        return f=="sum" ? sum(nums; init = 0) :
               isempty(nums) ? nothing : f=="min" ? minimum(nums) : maximum(nums)
    end
    f=="default" && return truth(v) ? v : a[1]
    f=="eq" && return text(v, n)==text(a[1], n)
    if f in ("pad", "lpad")
        s=text(v, n)
        fill=repeat(length(a)==1 ? " " : a[2], max(0, a[1]-length(s)))
        return f=="pad" ? s*fill : fill*s
    end
    if f=="truncate"
        s=text(v, n)
        return length(s)>a[1] ? part(s, 1, a[1])*"..." : s
    end
    f=="replace" && return replace(text(v, n), a[1]=>a[2])
    f=="join" && return v isa Vector ? join((text(x, n) for x in v), a[1]) : text(v, n)
    f=="sort" && return v isa Vector ?
           sort(v; by = x->rank(isempty(a) ? x : field(x, a[1])), alg = Base.Sort.MergeSort) : v
    f=="pluck" && return v isa Vector ? Any[field(x, a[1]) for x in v] : v
    x=number(v, f, n)
    y=a[1]
    f=="add" ? x+y :
    f=="sub" ? x-y :
    f=="mul" ? x*y : f=="div" ? fld(x, y) : f=="mod" ? mod(x, y) : f=="gt" ? x>y : x<y
end
function resolve(name, contexts, loops)
    name=="." && return true, last(contexts)
    if startswith(name, "@")
        isempty(loops) && return false, nothing
        i, count=last(loops)
        return true, name=="@index" ? i : name=="@number" ? i+1 : name=="@first" ? i==0 : i==count-1
    end
    parts=Any[occursin(r"^[0-9]+$", p) ? parse(BigInt, p) : String(p) for p in split(name, '.')]
    for context in reverse(contexts)
        if haspart(context, parts[1])
            v=context
            for p in parts
                haspart(v, p) || return false, nothing
                v=getpart(v, p)
            end
            return true, v
        end
    end
    false, nothing
end
escapehtml(s) = replace(s, '&'=>"&", '<'=>"<", '>'=>">", '"'=>""", '\''=>"'")
function render(nodes, contexts, loops, partials, strict, depth = 0)
    out=IOBuffer()
    for node in nodes
        k=node.kind
        n=node.number
        if k=='t'
            print(out, node.argument)
            continue
        end
        if k=='>'
            name=node.argument
            haskey(partials, name) || fail(n, "unknown partial '$name'")
            depth==8 && fail(n, "partial depth exceeded at '$name'")
            lines=[(i, isempty(s) ? s : node.indent*s) for (i, s) in partials[name]]
            print(out, render(source(lines), contexts, loops, partials, strict, depth+1))
            continue
        end
        name, filters=node.expression
        found, v=resolve(name, contexts, loops)
        !found && strict && k in ('v', '&') && fail(n, "missing '$name'")
        for (f, a) in filters
            v=applyfilter(f, a, v, n)
        end
        if k in ('v', '&')
            s=text(v, n)
            print(out, k=='&' ? s : escapehtml(s))
        elseif k=='^'
            !truth(v) && print(out, render(node.children, contexts, loops, partials, strict, depth))
        elseif v isa Vector
            for (i, x) in enumerate(v)
                print(
                    out,
                    render(
                        node.children,
                        [contexts; Any[x]],
                        [loops; [(i-1, length(v))]],
                        partials,
                        strict,
                        depth,
                    ),
                )
            end
        elseif truth(v)
            print(out, render(node.children, [contexts; Any[v]], loops, partials, strict, depth))
        end
    end
    String(take!(out))
end
notation(v) =
    v isa String ? "\""*replace(v, '\\'=>"\\\\", '"'=>"\\\"", '\n'=>"\\n")*"\"" :
    v isa Bool ? (v ? "true" : "false") : v isa Int ? string(v) : v isa Vector ? "[]" : "{}"
function leaves!(result, v, path)
    if v isa Dict && !isempty(v)
        for k in sort!(collect(keys(v)))
            leaves!(result, v[k], isempty(path) ? k : path*"."*k)
        end
    elseif v isa Vector && !isempty(v)
        for (i, x) in enumerate(v)
            leaves!(result, x, path*"[$(i-1)]")
        end
    elseif !isempty(path)
        push!(result, path*" = "*notation(v))
    end
end
function showtemplate(name, templates, root, partials, strict)
    try
        result=render(source(templates[name]), Any[root], Tuple{Int,Int}[], partials, strict)
        lines=isempty(result) ? String[] : String.(split(result, '\n'; keepempty = true))
        !isempty(lines) && isempty(last(lines)) && pop!(lines)
        println("TEMPLATE $name OK lines=$(length(lines)) chars=$(length(result))")
        foreach(println, lines)
    catch e
        e isa TemplateError || rethrow()
        println("TEMPLATE $name ERROR line $(e.number): $(e.reason)")
    end
end
function main()
    lines=readlines()
    root=Dict{String,Any}()
    partials=Dict{String,Vector{Tuple{Int,String}}}()
    templates=copy(partials)
    strict=false
    at=1
    while lines[at]!="END"
        line=lines[at]
        n=at
        fields=split(line, ' '; limit = 2)
        cmd=fields[1]
        name=length(fields)==2 ? String(fields[2]) : ""
        at+=1
        if cmd in ("DATA", "PARTIAL", "TEMPLATE")
            marker=cmd=="DATA" ? "ENDDATA" : cmd=="PARTIAL" ? "ENDPARTIAL" : "ENDTEMPLATE"
            body=Tuple{Int,String}[]
            while lines[at]!=marker
                push!(body, (at, lines[at]))
                at+=1
            end
            at+=1
            if cmd=="DATA"
                sets=0
                unsets=0
                errors=String[]
                for (i, s) in body
                    (isempty(s) || startswith(s, "#")) && continue
                    candidate=deepcopy(root)
                    try
                        if startswith(s, "UNSET ")
                            unset!(candidate, part(s, 7), i)
                            unsets+=1
                        else
                            assign!(candidate, s, i)
                            sets+=1
                        end
                        root=candidate
                    catch e
                        e isa TemplateError || rethrow()
                        push!(errors, "ERROR line $(e.number): $(e.reason)")
                    end
                end
                println("DATA set=$sets unset=$unsets errors=$(length(errors))")
                foreach(println, errors)
            elseif cmd=="PARTIAL"
                try
                    source(body)
                    status=haskey(partials, name) ? "REPLACED" : "DEFINED"
                    partials[name]=body
                    println("PARTIAL $name $status lines=$(length(body))")
                catch e
                    e isa TemplateError || rethrow()
                    println("PARTIAL $name ERROR line $(e.number): $(e.reason)")
                end
            else
                templates[name]=body
                showtemplate(name, templates, root, partials, strict)
            end
        elseif cmd=="RENDER"
            if haskey(templates, name)
                showtemplate(name, templates, root, partials, strict)
            else
                println("TEMPLATE $name ERROR line $n: unknown template '$name'")
            end
        elseif cmd=="DUMP"
            result=String[]
            leaves!(result, root, "")
            println("DUMP leaves=$(length(result))")
            foreach(println, result)
        elseif cmd=="STRICT"
            strict=name=="ON"
            println(line)
        elseif cmd=="RESET"
            empty!(root)
            empty!(partials)
            empty!(templates)
            println("RESET")
        end
    end
end
main()
